assumptions.text: Published node actionPolicy can determine business-page actions
assumptions.evidence: Workflow model adapter, validator and designer already persist allowedActions
assumptions.falsifier: A valid release workflow task has no resolvable policy or compatible default

assumptions.text: Single-task projection can authorize by tenant, task ID, current assignee and task state
assumptions.evidence: Existing inbox and decision SQL use these keys
assumptions.falsifier: Required business entity authorization is not represented by the workflow task

assumptions.text: Release Mock can reconstruct full details for approved fictional business keys
assumptions.evidence: Existing applications have unique code fields and are generated deterministically
assumptions.falsifier: Runtime task business keys cannot be mapped to any approved fixture

assumptions.text: Existing application shell supports the required phone widths
assumptions.evidence: Current design-h5 contract and responsive shell styles
assumptions.falsifier: Browser measurement finds shell-level overflow outside feature scope
